question: Which materials for vessels are enumerated in this part of the teaching?
premises: Vessels may be made of clay.
Vessels may be tortoise-born, bell-metal, or copper-metal.
inference: Several material types are listed as suitable for vessels.
uncertainties: The exact sense of 'kūrmajaṃ' as tortoise-born material is context-dependent.
plain_english: O goddess, they may be made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell-metal, or born of copper and metal.
